title: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 68

sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979 No 68
sections.section: ORDER - Chief Martial Law Administrator Order 1979, No. 68
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW
ADMINISTRATOR
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd August 1979]
No. 68
1.
This Martial Law Order shall come into force at once.
2.
Any person, wherever he may be, who has been found guilty of misconduct by a
Disqualification Tribunal established under any law relating to
disqualification for membership of the Legislative Assembly or the Council for
the time being in force in Azad Jammu & Kashmir shall not participate in
any manner whatsoever, directly or indirectly, in any political activity,
closed door or otherwise, until a period of seven years has elapsed following
the decision of the Tribunal.
